Name: Help Wanted Auto Accept
Author: Ruse82
Description:
[b]Help Wanted Auto Accept[/b] is a mod which automatically accepts the daily Help Wanted quest (from the notice board outside of Pierre's General Store) at the beginning of the day, if one is available.

The mod can also be configured to multiply the default time limit for these daily quests (normally 2 days). If set to zero or a negative number, daily quests will not expire.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods`.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Config[/size]
[list]
[*]You can change the config for this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu.[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with the latest version of Stardew Valley (1.6)
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/521]Luck Skill[/url]﻿ mod, which can add daily quests if none are normally available
[*]If using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22349]Quest Time Limits - Continued[/url]﻿ mod, the daily quest multiplier set in its config cannot be picked up by this mod, so has to be set independently.
[*]For some level of compatibility/automation with other mods which replace the daily quest board and/or create their own daily quests which can't be accepted automatically (for example, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21766]Help Wanted Redux For 1.6[/url]﻿), there is a config option to show the daily quest board at the start of the day so that they can be accepted manually, while still avoiding the trip to Pierre's!
[*]There may be incompatibility issues with other mods. I'd appreciate any feedback if there are issues.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added a config option to multiply the default time limit to complete Help Wanted quests.
